content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00079 For each asynchronous invocation of an operation prototype only one Asyn- chronousServerCallReturnsEvent shall be passed to the client component by the RTE. The AsynchronousServerCallReturnsEvent shall indicate either that the transmission was successful or that the transmission was not successful.
